create_CsmithBenchmark_from_bitcode: create a CsmithBenchmark from LLVM bitcode and C source bytes using the create class method
get_CsmithBenchmark_source: get the C source code string from a CsmithBenchmark instance using the source property
get_CsmithBenchmark_sources: get the list of BenchmarkSource objects from a CsmithBenchmark using the sources property
create_CsmithDataset: create a CsmithDataset instance with a custom csmith binary path and includes directory
generate_benchmark_from_seed: generate a CsmithBenchmark from a uint32 seed using CsmithDataset benchmark_from_seed method
